title: नेपालमा राजनीतिक दलको लोकतान्त्रिकरणमा नेपालको संविधान {Constitution of Nepal on democratization of political parties in Nepal}
nepali: नागरिकहरुको अभिमतको प्रतिबिम्बनको रुपमा निर्वाचन र त्यसलाई मुखरित गर्ने काममा राजनीतिक दलको भूमिका महत्वपूर्ण रहन्छ । नेपालका राजनीतिक दलले विभिन्न समयमा राजनीतिक परिवर्तन र त्यसलाई संस्थागत गर्न पु¥याएको योगदान, दलसँग सम्बन्धित संवैधानिक व्यवस्था र सिमाको विश्लेषण गर्दै उनीहरुको लोकतान्त्रिक आचरणलाई व्यवहारमा कार्यान्वयनमा ल्याउन देखा परेका समस्याहरुको विश्लेषणसँग यो लेख सम्बन्धित छ । राजनीतिक दल परिवर्तनका वहाक र लोकतन्त्रका पर्याय भएको हुनाले उनीहरुको लोकतान्त्रिक अवस्थाको पहिचानमा यो लेखको उद्देश्य केन्द्रिकृत छ । नेपालका राजनीतिक दल, संवैधानिक व्यवस्था र दलका लोकतान्त्रिकरणको आधारहरुको पहिचान गर्ने काम यो लेखमार्पmत व्यक्त गर्न खोजिएको छ । सूचना तथा तथ्याङ्कहरु द्वितीयक स्रोतमा आधारित छ । अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरिएको हुनाले लेख विश्लेषणात्मक र गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको रहेको छ । अध्ययन विश्लेषणको क्रममा राजनीतिक दलका लोकतान्त्रिकरणका आधारहरुलाई पहिल्याउने कोशिस गरिएको छ । लोकतान्त्रिक आचारणमा समेत नकरात्मक सन्देश प्रवाह भएको अवस्थामा सचेततापूर्वक आपूलाई समय सापेक्ष सुधार गर्दै अगाडि बढ्नु पर्ने निष्कर्ष र सुझाव यस लेख मार्फत प्रवाह गर्न खोजिएको छ ।
american_english: The role of political parties remains important in elections as a reflection of citizens' opinion and in giving voice to it. Analyzing the contribution made by Nepal's political parties at various times to political change and its institutionalization, the constitutional provisions relating to parties, and their limits, this article is concerned with the analysis of the problems that have emerged in implementing their democratic conduct in practice. Because political parties are carriers of change and synonyms of democracy, the objective of this article is centered on identifying their democratic condition. Through this article an attempt has been made to express the work of identifying Nepal's political parties, the constitutional provisions, and the bases of the democratization of parties. The information and statistics are based on secondary sources. Because the study has been analyzed, the article is of an analytical and qualitative nature. In the course of studying and analyzing, an attempt has been made to identify the bases of the democratization of political parties. In a situation where a negative message has also been conveyed in democratic conduct, this article seeks to convey the conclusion and suggestions that one must move forward by consciously improving oneself in keeping with the times.

informal_english: Elections reflect what citizens think, and political parties play a big role in giving that a voice. This piece looks at the problems that come up when trying to put Nepali political parties' democratic conduct into practice, digging into what they've contributed to political change and institutionalizing it over time, the constitutional rules around parties, and where those rules run out. Since political parties are basically the carriers of change and stand in for democracy, the whole point of the article is to figure out where their democratic condition actually stands. Through the article I've tried to lay out the work of identifying Nepal's political parties, the constitutional provisions, and the bases for democratizing parties. The info and stats come from secondary sources. Because the study's been analyzed, the article is analytical and qualitative. While studying and analyzing, I tried to pin down the bases for democratizing political parties. And where democratic conduct has sent a negative message too, the article passes along the takeaway and suggestions that you've got to keep moving forward by consciously improving yourself to keep up with the times.
